neighbours.label: sitting idly among an audience or in bed (sitting in the audience, sitting in bed waiting)
fire: The governor was sitting in the audience that night.
You may end up sitting in bed, waiting with worry.
The senator was sitting in the audience during the talk.
I found myself sitting in bed, waiting with dread.
The mayor's wife was sitting in the audience in silence.
He ended up sitting in bed, waiting with his phone.
The judge's son was sitting in the audience all evening.
She kept sitting in bed, waiting with no news.
quiet: The governor was giving a speech that night.
You may end up going to work, walking with worry.
The senator was reading the report during the talk.
I found myself at the desk, writing with care.
The mayor's wife was running the event with skill.
He ended up cooking dinner with his phone off.
The judge's son was washing the car all evening.
She kept working late, typing with no pause.

notes: Weak guess: 'sitting in the audience' and 'sitting in bed, waiting with' reached 0.83-0.92 in the probes, but 'sitting at the kitchen table' and 'sitting on the couch' stayed at 0.04 or less. I could not explain that difference.
